title: 同事与岗位
prompt_en: Look at the team. Who is this person?
prompt_zh: 看看这个团队。这个人是谁？
description: 学习用 he/she 介绍同事及其岗位
knowledge_points: he/she is, job titles (designer, manager, assistant, receptionist, engineer)
teaching_markdown:
## 同事与岗位

学习用第三人称 he/she 介绍同事及其岗位身份。

### 核心句块
- Mia is our colleague and designer.
- Emma is our manager.
- Ben is a front desk assistant.
- Sofia is the receptionist, and Alex is the engineer.

### 教学重点
- He/She is our...
- 名字 + is a/an...
- 区分 he 和 she 的使用

title: 部门与地点
description: 学习用肯定句说明同事所属部门和工作位置
knowledge_points: works in/at/for, department names (sales, support, design)
teaching_markdown:
## 部门与地点

学习说明同事的工作部门、位置和公司。

### 核心句块
- Sofia works in the sales department.
- Ben works in customer support.
- Mia works in design.
- He works at the front desk for a small company.

### 教学重点
- works in + 部门
- works at + 具体位置
- works for + 公司

title: 介绍一位同事
prompt_en: Introduce a colleague: their role and background.
prompt_zh: 介绍一位同事：角色和背景。
description: 学习用 his/her/our 说明同事的角色和背景
teaching_markdown:
## 介绍一位同事

学习用 his/her/our 说明同事的角色和特点。

### 核心句块
- His role is customer support.
- Her background is in visual design.
- She is our friendly colleague.
- Our manager knows his role and her background.

### 教学重点
- His/Her role is...
- His/Her background is...
- Our colleague is...

title: 联系信息
prompt_en: How can you reach this colleague?
description: 学习说明同事的分机、工位和联系方式
knowledge_points: reach at, extension, desk, directory, contact details
teaching_markdown:
## 联系信息

学习说明如何联系某位同事。

### 核心句块
- These are Ben's contact details.
- His extension is 204.
- His desk is beside the entrance.
- You can reach him through the staff directory.

### 教学重点
- You can reach him/her at...
- His/Her extension is...
- check the directory

title: 开始一天
prompt_en: How does this person start the day?
prompt_zh: 这个人怎么开始一天的工作？
description: 学习用肯定句描述同事开始工作时的基础动作
knowledge_points: starts, checks, opens, logs in, 第三人称 -s
teaching_markdown:
## 开始一天

学习描述同事开始工作的流程。

### 核心句块
- She starts work at nine.
- He checks the schedule first.
- She opens the calendar.
- He logs in before the first task.

### 教学重点
- 规则动词 +s
- 动作顺序描述

title: 电话与邮件
prompt_en: What communication duties does each person have?
prompt_zh: 每个人有什么通讯职责？
description: 学习用第三人称肯定句描述接听、书写、转发等通讯职责
knowledge_points: answers, writes, forwards, attaches, prints, 第三人称 -s/-es
teaching_markdown:
## 电话与邮件

学习描述接听、书写、转发等通讯职责。

### 核心句块
- He answers the main line.
- She writes the daily report.
- She forwards the report and attaches the document.
- He prints one copy for the front desk.

### 教学重点
- answers / writes / forwards / attaches / prints
- 第三人称 -s/-es

title: 帮助客户
prompt_en: How does this person help customers?
description: 学习描述服务人员如何接待、解释、提供方案并引导客户
knowledge_points: guides, explains, solves, offers, 第三人称 -s/-es
teaching_markdown:
## 帮助客户

学习描述接待客户、解释问题、提供方案。

### 核心句块
- He guides each customer to the right place.
- She explains the question clearly.
- He offers a simple solution.
- She solves basic customer problems.

### 教学重点
- guides / explains / solves
- 服务场景动词

title: 完成与跟进
prompt_en: How does this person finish and follow up?
prompt_zh: 这个人怎么完成和跟进工作？
description: 学习描述完成任务、赶截止时间和跟进
knowledge_points: finishes, tries, carries, follows up, 第三人称 -es/-ies
teaching_markdown:
## 完成与跟进

学习描述完成和跟进工作。

### 核心句块
- She finishes the task before the deadline.
- He tries to complete it by four.
- She follows up after she completes the report.
- He carries the copies downstairs.

### 教学重点
- finishes / tries / carries / follows up
- -es / -ies 变化

title: Does 问答
prompt_en: Ask and answer about this person's duties using Does.
prompt_zh: 用 Does 询问和回答这个人的职责。
description: 学习用 Does...? 询问第三人称工作信息并作简短回答
knowledge_points: Does, Yes he/she does, No he/she doesn't, confirms
teaching_markdown:
## Does 问答

学习用 Does 询问第三人称信息。

### 核心句块
- Does Ben start at eight? — No, he doesn't.
- Does Mia write the report? — Yes, she does.
- Please confirm the correct shift.
- This confirms each person's duty.

### 教学重点
- Does 后动词还原原形
- 简短回答

title: 询问具体信息
prompt_en: Ask about specific work details using question words.
prompt_zh: 用疑问词询问具体工作信息。
description: 学习使用 What/Where/When/Who does...? 获取具体信息
knowledge_points: What does, Where does, When does, Who does
teaching_markdown:
## 询问具体信息

学习用疑问词获取工作信息。

### 核心句块
- What task does she complete first?
- Where is her work location?
- When does he finish?
- Who is the right person for this detail?

### 教学重点
- 疑问词 + does + 动词原形
- 回答恢复第三人称

title: 否定与纠正
prompt_en: Correct the wrong information about this person.
prompt_zh: 纠正关于这个人的错误信息。
description: 学习用 doesn't + 动词原形否定错误信息并补充准确事实
knowledge_points: doesn't + base form, actually, instead, correction
teaching_markdown:
## 否定与纠正

学习否定错误信息和纠正。

### 核心句块
- That information is a mistake.
- She doesn't answer the line; she writes instead.
- He actually works at the front desk.
- This correction makes the fact accurate.

### 教学重点
- doesn't + 动词原形（不能 doesn't + 三单）
- actually / instead 自然纠正

title: have 与 has
prompt_en: Ask and answer about what this person has.
prompt_zh: 询问和回答这个人拥有什么。
description: 学习用 has 表达某人持有物品，在 Does 问句中还原为 have
knowledge_points: has, Does ... have, I have / She has / Does she have
teaching_markdown:
## have 与 has

学习 has 和 Does ... have 的转换。

### 核心句块
- She has a meeting at ten.
- He has the presentation equipment.
- Does she have the main file? — Yes, she does.
- The document is on her device.

### 教学重点
- have → has（第三人称）
- Does ... have?（have 还原）

title: 一个人与一组人
prompt_en: Compare one person and a group.
description: 学习对比单个人和一组人作主语的动词形式
knowledge_points: She works / They work, He has / They have
teaching_markdown:
## 一个人与一组人

学习单复数主语动词对比。

### 核心句块
- One individual writes; the group reviews.
- She is a staff member; they are staff members.
- Several members have different duties.
- The group works as one team.

### 教学重点
- She works / They work
- He has / They have

title: 谁负责
prompt_en: Who handles this task? Assign it.
prompt_zh: 谁负责这个任务？请指派。
description: 学习询问谁负责某项工作并完成任务指派
knowledge_points: Who handles, responsible for, assign to, transfer to
teaching_markdown:
## 谁负责

学习询问负责人和指派工作。

### 核心句块
- Who handles this? — Mia does.
- She is responsible for this task.
- Emma assigns the work to him.
- Please transfer the copies to them.

### 教学重点
- Who handles...?
- be responsible for...
- assign/transfer ... to him/her/them

title: 当前工作状态
prompt_en: Is this person available? What is their status?
prompt_zh: 这个人有空吗？什么状态？
description: 学习说明同事是否可联系、忙碌、紧急程度及返回时间
knowledge_points: available, occupied, urgent, delay, return, waiting
teaching_markdown:
## 当前工作状态

学习说明同事的工作状态。

### 核心句块
- Is she available now? — No, she is occupied.
- The request is not urgent.
- A short delay is okay.
- She returns at three, so he is waiting.

### 教学重点
- available / occupied
- urgent / delay / return

title: 同事工作档案
prompt_en: Create a complete work profile for a colleague.
prompt_zh: 为一位同事创建完整的工作档案。
description: 综合岗位、地点、职责、has 和团队对比制作同事档案
knowledge_points: introduce, describe, main, overall, summary, profile
teaching_markdown:
## 同事工作档案

学习综合制作同事档案。

### 核心句块
- Let me introduce her work profile.
- I can describe her main role.
- Overall, she supports the whole team.
- In summary, this profile is complete.

### 教学重点
- introduce / describe / main / overall / summary / profile
- 综合输出 8-10 句
